source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When the **[Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase)** of your opponent begins, this unit may use this level 2 psychic ability if it is free of Battle-shock, rolling one D6 as its **[psychic roll](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities)**. A result of 1 leaves the unit **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**. Having rolled, each enemy unit no more than 6″ away that **[Falls Back](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)** takes a **[Leadership roll](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls)** and, should it fail, is forced to **[Remain Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary)**.
